title: My Progress
sub: Your real numbers from attempts saved on your device. For your own tracking, not a diagnosis.
chartHint: Hover over or tap the bars to see the number
emptyText: Your real numbers appear here once you finish a challenge. We don't show sample numbers.
noAccuracy: You haven't played a scored challenge
monthLater: The month view appears once you have more than a week of history.
scoredNote: Each challenge calculates accuracy its own way, so compare a challenge with itself, not with others.
unscoredNote: These have no right answer, so we don't compare them with the ones above.
selfNote: This is what you recorded yourself, not something I concluded.
energyEmpty: You haven't recorded your energy yet.
noticedText: {{short}} of {{total}} completed challenges took a minute or less.
maybeText: Shorter challenges suit you better. That's only a guess, and you decide.
needMore: I need at least 4 attempts before mentioning any pattern.
disclaimer: Game results are for your own tracking. They don't show clinical improvement or a diagnosis.
